text:
The user asked the AI to take on the role of a relationship coach and provided a general request for assistance in resolving conflicts with a spouse.

Assistant A provides a comprehensive, structured set of actionable communication techniques. It explains "I" statements, active listening, and the difference between positions and interests, providing specific examples of what to say. This is highly practical and aligns well with the persona of a coach.

Assistant B provides very generic advice (talk it out, be honest, see a professional). While the advice is sound, it lacks the depth and specific "how-to" strategies that a user seeking coaching would find helpful.

Assistant A is much more helpful and detailed.

[[A]]
